name: Hidden Lives
source:
A romance story full of secrets and lies!
Ready to embark on his journey through a prestigious college, Korrin Tang moves to Japan with his mom to pursue his studies and make new friends. At first, his college life seemed pretty normal, until one day he discovers a secret his friends were hiding from him. Now with this newfound knowledge, he has to find a way to help them through their troubles. 

Will you be able to save them?

Most people seem to have something called a unique ability which gives them a special power. These powers ended up dividing society, and the two main groups are the Hero, and Villain organizations. 

[From [url=https://kyen-hl.itch.io/hidden-lives]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个充满秘密和谎言的浪漫故事！
唐科林 (Korrin Tang) 准备踏上著名大学的旅程，与妈妈一起搬到日本继续学业并结交新朋友。起初，他的大学生活似乎很正常，直到有一天，他发现了朋友们向他隐瞒的一个秘密。现在有了这些新知识，他必须找到一种方法来帮助他们度过难关。

你能拯救他们吗？

大多数人似乎都有一种独特的能力，赋予他们特殊的力量。这些权力最终分裂了社会，两个主要群体是英雄组织和恶棍组织。

[来自[url=https://kyen-hl.itch.io/hidden-lives]Itch.io[/url]]
